policy: Maps AI payload envelope names and root labels only. Segment fields map through contract alias crosswalks or a unique Chapter 13 name that is also anchored by the same segment's rule catalog; anything else is REVIEW_REQUIRED.

Software Load Phone Response.evidence: Section 11 Phone Load Response is the source family; actual load segments are identified by Element 24, not by producer metadata.

Date & Time Load Response.evidence: Section 11 Date and Time Load Response is the exact source family; the producer abbreviation is only a candidate label.

ECA/TeleCheck Service Transaction Reques.evidence: The extracted Section 11 request template is named ECA/TeleCheck Service Transaction; its response is a separate family.

Financial Request.evidence: Section 11.8.1 lists Segment 130 as required for the EMV Financial Transaction Request; Section 11.1.1 does not list Segment 130.

MessageType.evidence: Data Section 1 field 1 is Element 55 Message Format Version Identifier; AI value domain is ATL105.

NumSegments.evidence: Data Section 1 field 2 is Element 63 Number of Segments.
